steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Muslims believe in qadr (predestination) — that Allah has foreknowledge and control over all things. However, most Muslims also believe humans have free will to choose their actions. The relationship between God's decree and human freedom is one of the most debated topics in Islamic theology. | Exam Tip: The key tension: if Allah has already decreed everything, how can humans be responsible for their actions? Most Muslims resolve this by saying Allah's foreknowledge is not the same as forcing — he knows what you will freely choose. You are still responsible. | RS Exam Tips — Predestination and Free Will: 1. For Predestination and Free Will questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2.
